satisfies: Test whether `version` satisfies `range`. Both `version` and `range` may be strings, in which case they will be parsed.
constants: An object containing the comparison operator constants.
Version: Create a new version with the given `major`, `minor`, and `patch` components.
build: An array of build metadata tags.
compare: Compare `version` with `other`, returning `1` if `version` is greater, `-1` if less, or `0` if equal. Comparison follows the Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 specification, including prerelease precedence rules.
Comparator.toString: Return the string representation of the comparator (operator and version), for example `>=1.2.3`.
Range.toString: Return the string representation of the range, for example `>=1.2.3 <2.0.0`.
Version.parse: Parse a semantic version string into a `Version` instance.
Comparator: Create a new comparator with the given `operator` constant and `version`.
Range: Create a new range from a two-dimensional array of `Comparator` instances. Each inner array represents a set of comparators joined by intersection, and the outer array represents the union of those sets.
Range.parse: Parse a range string into a `Range` instance. Supports comparison operators (`<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`, `=`), partial versions, and logical OR (`||`).
